title: Strategic Importance of Submarines to Singapore's Ability to Protect Territorial Waters and Contribute to Regional Security
what_it_is: Strategic Importance of Submarines to Singapore's Ability to Protect Territorial Waters and Contribute to Regional Security

sections.label: Navy submarines replacement
sections.summary: Singapore's ageing Challenger-class and Archer-class submarines will be replaced by four new Invincible-class submarines to enhance the Navy's capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Within our Navy, which is tasked with the crucial mission of keeping these lines open, submarines are a strategic asset.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: With their stealth, submarines complement our surface fleet in countering surface and sub-surface threats and serve as a deterrence to potential aggressors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Our second-hand Challenger-class and Archer-class submarines, which are more than 60 years and 40 years old respectively, will be retired soon.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: They will be replaced by four Invincible-class submarines that are the Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) first new-built submarines designed for our needs and operational requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Equipped with an advanced rudder drive system, the new submarines can better conduct manoeuvres in our shallow and busy tropical waters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: They are designed to stay submerged for 50% longer than the Archer-class submarines and are equipped with better sensors and combat systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Overall, the new submarines will significantly enhance the Navy's capabilities to protect Singapore's interests at sea.

sections.label: Manpower constraint in defence
sections.summary: MINDEF and SAF are acutely aware of the manpower constraint and prioritise using manpower well while designing and buying equipment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: This would also apply to our naval assets and, indeed, also in the design of our submarines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: So, I just wanted to give the Member and all Members of this House this assurance that MINDEF and SAF are acutely aware of the manpower constraint, and this is one of the top priorities as we make best use of this manpower and, at the same time, design, buy and equip our forces with equipment and assets that will serve our operational purpose.
